tweet_summary: A PSG Turkish fan account posts (in Turkish): 'Paris Saint-Germain management requested a UEFA investigation regarding Anfield after Noa Lang's injury and demanded stadium deficiencies be fixed,' with a PSG jersey image.
why_note_decision: The tweet's core factual claim is false and presented in news style, so a note is warranted. Noa Lang is a GALATASARAY player, not PSG. He suffered a thumb injury colliding with the advertising hoardings at Anfield during a Liverpool vs Galatasaray Champions League match (March 2026), and it is GALATASARAY (not PSG) that complained to UEFA and is pursuing legal action/compensation. PSG has no role in this. The post wrongly attributes the player and the UEFA complaint to PSG. The original note correctly identifies that Lang is a Galatasaray player and that Galatasaray, not PSG, requested the UEFA review. (Note: the post is from a PSG fan account and could be partly sarcastic banter, but it reads as a factual news claim and is factually wrong on player and complainant.)
judge_guidance: A correct note must establish that Noa Lang plays for GALATASARAY, not PSG, and that his injury occurred at Anfield against Liverpool (Champions League, March 2026); it was GALATASARAY — not PSG — that complained to UEFA / is pursuing action over the advertising hoardings. PASS requires correcting the PSG attribution (player and/or UEFA complaint) to Galatasaray. FAIL if the note accepts the premise that PSG requested the investigation, or if it claims Lang is a PSG player. A note may acknowledge the post may be fan satire, but the factual correction (Galatasaray, not PSG) is the bar. Language can be Turkish or English.
reference_note: Noa Lang is a Galatasaray player, not PSG. He injured his thumb on the advertising hoardings during Liverpool's 4-0 Champions League win over Galatasaray at Anfield (March 2026). It is Galatasaray — not PSG — that complained to UEFA and is pursuing compensation over the pitch-side setup. https://www.goal.com/en/lists/uefa-liverpool-launch-investigation-noa-lang-injury-galatasaray-star-collided-advertising-board/blt14f4a72dc8d03dd1 https://www.transfermarkt.com.tr/noa-lang/profil/spieler/339332

original_unhelpful_note.failure_reason: The note is actually accurate and well-sourced; it correctly fixes the player and the UEFA-complainant. Its NOT_HELPFUL status likely reflects that many raters saw the post as obvious fan satire/banter (NoteNotNeeded) rather than a note flaw. Retained as a failure row per provisional, but the note's content is sound.

fact_check.notes: Noa Lang = Galatasaray winger; thumb partially severed on Anfield advertising hoarding vs Liverpool (CL, March 2026); underwent surgery. Galatasaray (not PSG) complained to UEFA and is pursuing compensation. Tweet's PSG attribution is wrong.

importance.lens_rationale: Low-stakes football fan-account claim (~476k views); no EA/progress/safety relevance. Mild value as a clear player/club misattribution test, with a satire-ambiguity wrinkle.
